# SomDvps

> SomDvps (also written Som Dvps, Som DVPS or SOMDVPS) is Somalia DevOps. Its official website is https://somdvps.org. Something bigger is coming to the site soon.

SomDvps is the team behind the Som DVPS Discord bot, a multi-purpose bot that helps community managers, server owners and moderators run better communities, and related developer tools such as the Som Dvps Code editor. It is run by Yusuf Mohamed.

## Official links

- [Website](https://somdvps.org): the official SomDvps homepage
- [Yusuf Mohamed — portfolio](https://yusuf.somdvps.org): the founder's portfolio
- [GitHub — yousumohamed](https://github.com/yousumohamed): source code and projects
